subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: P.B. Shelley was one of the famous poets in English literature. He is known for his lyric poetry. The life of this great poet was full of struggle. He was expelled from his University for writing an atheistic pamphlet. After his grandfather's death, he became the owner of a vast property. This ample solvency helped him to involve in literature fully. Unfortunately, this great genius died by a boat capsize when he was only thirty.
